about: Purpose: frozen oracle for the routine called at $AD1B -- one case per distinct (site, PC set), at most a few each: SP and the registers (SkoolKit indices in regs) at the CALL, the bytes read before written as [addr, hex] runs (in; fetches and the call frame excepted), every byte written outside the frame (out), the registers at the return (exit), R at the call and the return (r, rx), the port reads in order as [port, value] (ports), the uncontended T (t); code lists the fetched addresses, whose bytes come from the target, as do ROM data reads (rom, addresses only, D5); outputs inside the blind ranges are addresses only (blind). Read by: python tools/callio.py --check, and the JS gate of that routine.
